price.basis: Search is free: the pricing page prints $0.00 per request at 30 requests per minute and 500 per hour, while the Search API page says free up to 12,000 requests per day with a positive wallet balance beyond; Search never draws on the wallet

reachability.note: The vendor's pages state no regional availability.

tinyfish-search-api.source: TinyFish documentation, Search API page, docs.tinyfish.ai/search-api
tinyfish-search-api.note: A synchronous web search: GET https://api.search.tinyfish.ai?query=… with optional `location`, `language`, `recency_minutes` or `after_date`/`before_date`, `domain_type` (web, news, research_paper) and `purpose`; JSON `{query, results[], total_results, page}`, each result `position`, `site_name`, `title`, `snippet`, `url`; the example returns 10 results. "Search is free up to 12,000 requests per day."

tinyfish-authentication.note: "All REST API requests require an API key passed in the `X-API-Key` header."

tinyfish-pricing.source: TinyFish pricing page, www.tinyfish.ai/pricing, with the Agent API and runs pages (docs.tinyfish.ai/agent-api, docs.tinyfish.ai/key-concepts/runs)
tinyfish-pricing.note: Search "$0.00 per request", "30 requests / min · 500 requests / hour"; Fetch (POST https://api.fetch.tinyfish.ai) free; the Agent API (POST https://agent.tinyfish.ai/v1/automation/run, run-async, run-sse; `url` + `goal`; 150 steps by default, 500 at most) $0.016 per step with 2 concurrent runs; Browser $0.002 per minute; new accounts receive $8 of wallet funds. No regional statement.

openQuestions: The two pages state different free limits for Search (12,000 per day against 500 per hour); the evaluation stays far below both.
The accepted values of `language` and `location` are not listed; the evaluation sends the query alone.
notes: TinyFish's interface reading (Issue #883): TinyFish is primarily a web-agent platform, but it documents a plain keyed search endpoint beside the agent, so the evaluation measures that endpoint and never the per-step Agent API.
